# rixl_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists active API keys generated for an organization or project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_api_keys" "all" {
  org_id = var.rixl_org_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `paginationlimit` (Number) Maximum number of items to return.
- `paginationoffset` (Number) Number of items to skip before collecting the result set.

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))
- `total` (String)
